features.notes: Web Highlights supports offline highlighting without requiring an account. Highlights can be made offline and persist even after page refresh.

Web Highlights specializes in highlighting any website or PDF. Users can select text and click the highlighter icon. Highlights persist after page refresh and are accessible from any device with the web app.
Supports PDF highlighting and annotation alongside web highlighting with the same interface and persistence features.
Primary function is text highlighting and capture from web pages and PDFs with persistent storage.
Supports creating notes and annotations alongside highlights with tagging capabilities.
Premium features include organizing highlighted pages with tags and creating collections of highlights.
Web app provides overview of all highlighted pages with search and organization capabilities.
